_README: Labelled from source. OrderMapper is a MyBatis mapper interface; mapper/OrderMapper.xml (namespace shop.order.OrderMapper) implements findByCustomer as a <select> over orders JOIN customers, with an <include> column fragment and a <where>/<if> dynamic clause, and insertOrder as an INSERT INTO orders. Each interface method is bound to its statement, and each statement reads/writes its tables.

hard_case.catalog: MyBatis mapper XML: namespace + id ↔ interface method; statement SQL → tables
